acceptance: rectangle in contain vs overlap mode: given an axis-aligned rectangle at (0, 0, 100, 100), expect a partial lasso clipping only part of the rectangle selects it in overlap mode and leaves it unselected in contain mode, while a full-enclosure lasso selects it in both modes

diamond in contain vs overlap mode: given a diamond at (0, 0, 100, 100), expect a partial lasso clipping only part of the diamond selects it in overlap mode and leaves it unselected in contain mode, while a full-enclosure lasso selects it in both modes

ellipse in contain vs overlap mode: given an ellipse at (0, 0, 100, 100), expect a partial lasso clipping only part of the ellipse selects it in overlap mode and leaves it unselected in contain mode, while a full-enclosure lasso selects it in both modes

rotated shape in contain vs overlap mode: given a rotated rectangle with non-zero angle, expect a partial lasso clipping only part of the rotated shape selects it in overlap mode and leaves it unselected in contain mode, while a full-enclosure lasso selects it in both modes

line and arrow in contain vs overlap mode: given a line element and an arrow element, expect a partial lasso enclosing only one endpoint selects them in overlap mode and leaves them unselected in contain mode, while a full-enclosure lasso selects them in both modes

freedraw stroke in contain vs overlap mode: given a freedraw element with multiple points, expect a partial lasso enclosing only part of the stroke selects it in overlap mode and leaves it unselected in contain mode, while a full-enclosure lasso selects it in both modes

bound text follows its container in contain vs overlap mode: given a rectangle container with a bound text element inside it, expect a lasso enclosing only the bound text inside the container selects nothing in contain mode and selects the container in overlap mode, while a lasso enclosing the entire container selects the container in both modes
